frame_rate.description: A frame rate as an exact fraction: num / den frames per second (24000/1001, 25/1...). One frame lasts 254016000000 * den / num ticks.

output_module.description: An output module: how rendered frames are encoded and where they go. Every field is optional; defaults as given.

alpha_mode.description: How alpha is written. Default `Straight`. `Straight`: straight; `Premultiplied`: premultiplied.

audio.description: Audio output. Default `Auto`. `Auto`: sound is written when the composition has any; `On`: always; `Off`: never.

audio_channels.description: Channels of the written sound: 1 or 2. Default 2.

audio_format.description: Sample format. Default `S16`. `S16`: 16-bit integer; `S24`: 24-bit integer; `F32`: 32-bit float.

audio_sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the written sound, Hz. Default 48000.

bitrate_kbps.description: Target bit rate in kbit/s. Default 10000.

channels.description: Channels written. Default `Rgb`. `Rgb`: colour; `Rgba`: colour and alpha; `Alpha`: alpha as grey.

codec.description: Options of the HEVC / AV1 encoders. All optional.

anyOf.description: The codec level times 10 (HEVC 4.1 = 41); null: chosen by the encoder.

level.description: The codec level times 10 (HEVC 4.1 = 41); null: chosen by the encoder.

rate_control.description: Rate control. Default `Bitrate`. `Bitrate`: by `bitrate_kbps`; `Quality`: constant quality.

crop.description: Crop of the rendered frame. All optional; default no crop.

anyOf.description: x, y, width, height in composition pixels.

roi.description: x, y, width, height in composition pixels.

top.description: Pixels removed at the top (negative adds).

use_roi.description: Crop to the region of interest in `roi`.

format.description: Output format. Default `H264`. `H264`: H.264 in MP4; `ProRes`: ProRes in QuickTime; `PngSequence`: numbered PNG files; `JpegSequence`: numbered JPEG files; `TiffSequence`: numbered TIFF files; `ExrSequence`: numbered OpenEXR files; `Gif`: animated GIF; `WebM`: WebM; `Wav`: sound only, WAV; `Aiff`: sound only, AIFF; `Hevc`: HEVC in MP4; `Av1`: AV1 in MP4; `Uncompressed`: uncompressed video in AVI.

gif_loop.description: GIF: loops for ever. Default true.

include_project_link.description: The output's metadata names the project it was rendered from. Default true.

keyframe_interval.description: Frames between key frames; 0 = the encoder's own choice. Default 0.

name.description: The name of the template. Default empty.

opus_application.description: Opus tuning. Default `Audio`. `Audio`: music and mixed sound; `Voip`: speech.

opus_bitrate_kbps.description: Opus bit rate in kbit/s. Default 192.

output.description: The output file name or path template as the user set it. A destination on the computer that rendered: content text, never read by a reader of this file. Default `[compName].[fileExtension]`.

prores_profile.description: ProRes flavour. Default `Hq`. `Proxy`: 422 Proxy; `Lt`: 422 LT; `Standard`: 422; `Hq`: 422 HQ; `P4444`: 4444; `P4444Xq`: 4444 XQ.

resize.description: Resize of the rendered frame. All optional.

lock_aspect.description: The editor keeps the aspect ratio. Default true.

webm_bitrate.description: WebM: rate-controlled by `bitrate_kbps` instead of `quality`. Default false.

webm_codec.description: WebM video codec. Default `Vp9`. `Vp9`: VP9; `Av1`: AV1.

render_settings.description: Render settings: how the composition is rendered. Every field is optional; defaults as given.

color_depth.description: Colour depth. Default `Current`. `Current`: the project's; `Bpc8`: 8 bits per channel; `Bpc16`: 16 bits per channel; `Bpc32`: 32-bit float.

effects.description: Effects. Default `Current`. `Current`: as the layers' switches are; `AllOn`: every effect runs; `AllOff`: no effect runs.

field_render.description: Field rendering. Default `Off`. `Off`: progressive frames; `UpperFirst`: interlaced, upper field first; `LowerFirst`: interlaced, lower field first.

frame_blending.description: Frame blending per layer. Default `Current`. `Current`: as the layers' switches are; `OnForChecked`: on for layers whose switch is on, whatever the composition's switch says; `OffForAll`: off for every layer.

anyOf.description: The rate rendered at; null: the composition's.

frame_rate.description: The rate rendered at; null: the composition's.

guide_layers.description: Guide layers. Default `AllOff`. `Current`: as they are in the composition; `AllOff`: guide layers are not rendered.

motion_blur.description: Motion blur is rendered. Default true.

motion_blur_mode.description: Motion blur per layer. Default `Current`. `Current`: as the layers' switches are; `OnForChecked`: on for layers whose switch is on, whatever the composition's switch says; `OffForAll`: off for every layer.

name.description: The name of the template these settings came from or are saved as. Default empty.

proxy_use.description: Which proxies stand in. Default `UseNone`. `CurrentSettings`: proxies whose switch is on; `UseAll`: every proxy; `UseCompOnly`: composition proxies only; `UseNone`: no proxy.

pulldown.description: 3:2 pulldown. Default `Off`. `Off`: none; `Wssww`: 3:2 pulldown, phase WSSWW; `Sswww`: phase SSWWW; `Swwws`: phase SWWWS; `Wwwss`: phase WWWSS; `Wwssw`: phase WWSSW.

quality.description: Quality. Default `Best`. `Best`: full quality; `Draft`: draft quality.

resolution.description: Output scale relative to the composition's size: 1 = full, 0.5 = half. Default 1.

skip_existing.description: Frames of an image sequence that already exist are not rendered again. Default false.

solo.description: Solo switches. Default `Current`. `Current`: solo switches apply; `AllOff`: solo switches are ignored.

storage_overflow.description: When the output volume is full, continue in the overflow folders. Default true.

end.description: End of the span. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

start.description: First rendered instant. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

time_span.description: The span of composition time that is rendered. Default `WorkArea`. `kind` says which: `WorkArea`: the composition's work area; `LengthOfComp`: the whole composition; `Custom`: from `start` (inclusive) to `end` (exclusive).

description: The render queue of the project, its render-settings and output-module templates, and its render preferences. Nothing here changes what a composition looks like; it says what the user asked to be rendered, how, and where to.

notify.description: Notify when the queue finishes. Default false.

items.description: A folder on the computer that rendered: content text.
One entry of the render queue.

comp.description: Id of the composition to render.

extra_outputs.description: Further output modules of the same render. Default none.

id.description: The entry's id, unique in the queue.

anyOf.description: The file the last render wrote, as a path on the computer that rendered: content text, never read by a reader of this file.

last_output.description: The file the last render wrote, as a path on the computer that rendered: content text, never read by a reader of this file.

log.description: What the render log records. Default `ErrorsOnly`. `ErrorsOnly`: errors; `PlusSettings`: errors and settings; `PlusPerFrameInfo`: errors, settings and per-frame information.

post_render.description: What happens after the render. Default `None`. `None`: nothing; `Import`: import the output into the project; `ImportAndReplace`: import it and use it in place of the composition; `SetProxy`: set it as the composition's proxy.

render.description: The entry is ticked to be rendered.

anyOf.description: How long the last render took, seconds.

render_time.description: How long the last render took, seconds.

anyOf.description: When the last render started: seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

started.description: When the last render started: seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

defaults.description: Which template is the default for which kind of render.

items.description: [slot, template name]: slot is `Movie`, `Still`, `PreRender`, `MovieProxy` or `StillProxy`; the name is that of a template in the list beside it.
[slot, template name]: slot is `Movie`, `Still`, `PreRender`, `MovieProxy` or `StillProxy`; the name is that of a template in the list beside it.
